reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is creating, editing, autosaving, and exporting Excalidraw diagrams within DeepSeek Harness sessions.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中将文章内容转换为可编辑的 Excalidraw 图表，并支持预览、自动保存和导出。
summaries.en: Creates editable Excalidraw diagrams from DeepSeek Harness session content with preview, autosave, and export support.

capabilities: Creates editable Excalidraw diagrams from session content
Provides an embedded canvas editor and inline preview
Reads bounded diagram scene summaries into the conversation
Autosaves diagrams to plugin-owned session storage
Exports diagrams as Excalidraw, SVG, or PNG files
